data.action: 手扶天台栏杆随晚风回眸微笑，红丝带轻扬
data.animaCaption: Resting one hand on the school rooftop railing as evening breezes lift her black hair and crimson ribbon, she glances back with a gentle smile bathed in golden sunset light.
data.camera: 中景，平视，城市与学院钟楼远景
data.description: 落日熔金的星炬学院顶楼天台上，晚风吹动铁丝网旁的樱花瓣与千咲的乌黑长直发，她身着黑红缎带水手校服手扶栏杆温柔回眸。
data.lighting: 夕阳金橙逆光勾勒发丝轮廓与温暖光晕
data.location: 星炬学院顶楼夕阳天台
data.promptProse: On the sunlit rooftop of Startorch Academy at dusk, Chisa rests one hand along the railing in her black-and-crimson sailor uniform, turning back with a warm smile as sunset rims her straight black hair.
data.title: 千咲 · 星炬学院夕阳天台栏杆微风回眸
